rca_of_the_issue: Original 500 was an AttributeError in _has_ledger_access — code assumed roles was a list of dicts but franchise-owner sessions store roles as a dict (key->bool). Fix added isinstance(roles, dict) handling. Verified that FO session.roles is dict-shaped via login response. Also fixed the ledger gate to honor explicit owner_ledger release (report_type='owner_ledger') in addition to general visibility, so Accounts can selectively release ledgers without unlocking the full Owner Report. Frontend OwnerReports gating moved from `visible` to `canDownload = visible || canBypassRelease`, allowing SA/Admin/Accounts to see download buttons even on unreleased months.
